title: 清洁技术机遇
summary: 评估公司通过清洁技术满足市场需求的能力，包括专利、研发与收入占比。

sections.title_en: Introduction
sections.title_cn: 引言

blocks.content: This document provides essential information on the components of the Opportunities in Clean Tech Key Issue to enable users of ESG Ratings to understand how MSCI Sustainability & Climate’s (MSCI S&C’s)1 outputs are determined. Opportunities in Clean Tech is a Key Issue in the Environmental Pillar of the MSCI ESG Ratings model. Companies are evaluated on their positioning to meet market demand for products with environmental benefits.
blocks.content_cn: 本文件介绍清洁技术机遇关键议题各组成部分的核心信息，帮助 ESG 评级使用者理解 MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队（MSCI S&C）¹ 如何形成评估结果。清洁技术机遇属于 MSCI ESG 评级模型环境支柱下的关键议题。公司评估考察其满足具有环境效益产品市场需求的布局与能力。

blocks.content: For additional details on the MSCI ESG Ratings Model, refer to the Data, ratings and scores section of “ESG Ratings Methodology.”
blocks.content_cn: 关于MSCI ESG评级模型的更多细节，请参阅《ESG评级方法论》中"数据、评级和分数"部分。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Clean Tech Key Issue score
sections.title_cn: 清洁技术机遇关键议题得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Clean Tech Key Issue score evaluates the company’s level of exposure to, and management of, opportunities on this Key Issue. The Key Issue score is based on the Exposure score and the Management score using the formula below. The Exposure score and the Management score are combined such that the Exposure score determines the weight placed on the Management score, ranging from 50% (when Exposure score is equal to zero) to 100% (when Exposure score is equal to 10).
blocks.content_cn: 清洁技术机遇关键议题得分评估公司在此议题上的机遇敞口及机遇管理水平。该得分根据敞口得分与管理得分，按下列公式计算。二者的结合方式为：敞口得分决定管理得分的权重，范围从 50%（敞口得分为零）至 100%（敞口得分为 10）。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Clean Tech Strategy score
sections.title_cn: 清洁技术机遇战略得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Clean Tech Strategy score evaluates the company’s initiatives to embed clean technology into its long-term strategy through business focus, R&D direction, and investment targets. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 清洁技术机遇战略得分评估公司通过业务重点、研发方向和投资目标，将清洁技术纳入长期战略的举措。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

sections.title_en: • Targets to increase investment in clean tech
sections.title_cn: • 增加清洁技术投资的目标

blocks.content: Definition: Indicates whether the company has disclosed quantitative targets to increase investment in clean technology.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：表明公司是否披露了增加清洁技术投资的量化目标。

sections.title_en: • Strategic focus on clean technology development
sections.title_cn: • 对清洁技术开发的战略重视程度

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s strategic commitment to clean technology as part of its core business focus and growth plans. Highest performance reflects clean technology being a core business line or a primary focus for future R&D and innovation. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司将清洁技术作为核心业务重点及增长规划组成部分的战略承诺。最高水平表现为清洁技术已成为核心业务线，或未来研发与创新的主要重点。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Clean Tech Programs & Initiatives score
sections.title_cn: 清洁技术机遇项目与举措得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Clean Tech Programs & Initiatives score evaluates the company’s initiatives to advance clean technology through research and development. It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong initiatives.
blocks.content_cn: 清洁技术机遇计划与举措得分评估公司通过研发推进清洁技术的举措。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示相关举措有力。

blocks.content: • Research and development intensity (as percentage of sales) score
blocks.content_cn: • 研发强度得分（占销售额的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on R&D intensity metrics (including R&D intensity normalized by sales, and trend in R&D intensity) relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates the highest level of performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司研发强度指标（包括按销售额标准化的研发强度及其变化趋势）相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表最高绩效水平。

sections.title_en: ◦ R&D intensity(% of sales) industry relative score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 研发强度行业相对得分（占销售额的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s performance on R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) relative to its industry peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司研发强度（占销售额的百分比）相对于行业同业的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average R&D intensity(% of sales)
sections.title_cn: • 三年平均研发强度（占销售额的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales).
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司研发强度（占销售额的百分比）的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: ◦ R&D intensity (% of sales) industry relative trend score
sections.title_cn: ◦ 研发强度趋势行业相对得分（占销售额的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Assesses the company’s three-year average of year-over-year R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) trend, relative to its peers. Expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：评估公司研发强度（占销售额的百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均值相对于同行的表现。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Three-year average R&D intensity trend (% of sales)
sections.title_cn: • 研发强度趋势的三年平均值（占销售额的百分比）

blocks.content: Definition: Measures the company’s three-year average of year-over-year R&D intensity (as a percentage of sales) trend.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：衡量公司研发强度（占销售额的百分比）同比变化趋势的三年平均值。

sections.title_en: Opportunities in Clean Tech Performance score
sections.title_cn: 清洁技术机遇绩效得分

blocks.content: The Opportunities in Clean Tech Performance score evaluates the company's performance on clean technology metrics (including revenue generation from clean technology products and services). It is expressed as a 0–10 score, where 10 indicates strong performance.
blocks.content_cn: 清洁技术机遇绩效得分评估公司清洁技术指标的表现，包括清洁技术产品和服务产生的收入。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分表示表现强劲。

sections.title_en: • Clean tech revenue score
sections.title_cn: • 清洁技术收入得分

blocks.content: Definition: The percentage of the company's revenue from clean tech activities. Expressed as a 0-10 score, where 10 indicates that the company derives more than 50% of its revenue from clean technology products and services.
blocks.content_cn: 定义：公司收入中来自清洁技术活动的比例。以 0—10 分表示，10 分代表公司超过 50% 的收入来自清洁技术产品和服务。

sections.title_en: Business Segment Exposure score
sections.title_cn: 业务分部风险敞口得分

blocks.content: The Business Segment Exposure score of a business segment is based on a mapping of the business segment as disclosed by the company to a corresponding business activity. MSCI S&C uses the Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system along with industry-specific adjustments to define business activities. The score associated with a business activity is used to calculate a Business Segment Exposure score. Each business activity score is determined by a weighted average of the Research and Development Expense score of the activity and Contribution of Opportunities in Clean Tech score of the activity:
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部敞口得分以公司披露的业务分部与相应业务活动的映射关系为基础。MSCI 可持续发展与气候团队使用标准行业分类（SIC）体系，并结合行业特定调整来界定业务活动。业务活动对应的得分用于计算业务分部敞口得分。各业务活动得分由该活动的研发费用得分与清洁技术机遇贡献得分的加权平均值确定：

blocks.content_cn: 业务活动 j 的研发费用得分。

blocks.content_cn: 业务活动 j 的清洁技术机遇贡献得分。

blocks.content: A business segment's Research and Development Expense score is assessed using the ratio of research and development expenses to revenues at the business activity level. The Research and Development Expense score is scored on a 0-10 scale, with 10 corresponding to the highest research and development expenses per unit of revenue and 0 corresponding to the lowest research and development expenses per unit of revenue.
blocks.content_cn: 业务分部的研发费用得分采用业务活动层面研发费用与收入的比率评估。该得分采用 0—10 分制，10 分对应最高单位收入研发费用，0 分对应最低单位收入研发费用。

blocks.content: The Contribution of Opportunities in Clean Tech score of a business activity is assessed using a qualitative assessment based on predefined guidance to determine whether the business activity is a major contributor to opportunities in clean technology. Segments which are major contributors receive a score of 10. Segments with no potential opportunities in clean technology receive a score of 0.
blocks.content_cn: 业务活动的清洁技术机遇贡献得分，依据预先规定的指引，通过定性评估确定该活动是否为清洁技术机遇的主要贡献者。主要贡献分部得 10 分，不存在潜在清洁技术机遇的分部得 0 分。
